about-us.title: About Us

texts: We are a group of caring professionals at Bluestar Care & Support Ltd who are committed to improving the lives of those we serve. Founded on principles of empathy, excellence, and integrity, our mission is to offer personalized support that caters to the unique needs and desires of each individual.

We believe in providing care that goes beyond basic needs, focusing on comprehensive well-being that includes physical, emotional, social, and mental health. Our holistic approach ensures that our clients not only receive the essential care they need but also enjoy enriched and fulfilling lives.

Bluestar Care & Support Ltd envisions a world where care and support are not merely duties but heartfelt connections that empower individuals to live with dignity, grace, and joy. We strive to create an environment where every client feels at home, valued, and part of our extended family.

Our extensive range of services includes Grocery Shopping, Light Housekeeping, Meal Prep and Nutrition, Social Activities and Connection, Transportation and Errands, Cognitive Engagement, and Meaningful Activities. Tailored to suit individual preferences and requirements, our services aim to provide comfort, independence, and joy in everyday living.

Our dedicated team of caregivers, support staff, and healthcare professionals are at the heart of our success. Highly trained and committed to our values, they work collaboratively to deliver quality care with warmth and respect. Their unwavering commitment ensures that Bluestar is a name synonymous with trust and excellence in care.

Bluestar Care & Support Ltd adheres to the highest standards of quality, maintaining rigorous protocols to ensure that our clients receive the best possible care. We are constantly seeking ways to innovate and enhance our services, keeping abreast of the latest developments in healthcare and support.

We are proud to be part of the local communities we serve, actively participating in community events and supporting local causes. We believe that building strong community connections enriches the lives of our clients and contributes positively to the areas we operate in.

Pegasus Healthcare is an accredited employer with the Living Wage Foundation. We are committed to our workers and to pay them a fair rate of pay. The benefits of doing this are to allow them more financial stability to help them spend more time with their families, to spend more time relaxing and exercising and to generally enjoy a higher quality of life. The threshold of the Living Wage is the minimum that Pegasus Healthcare commits to but we are dedicated to pass on the highest possible rates of pay to all staff

Pegasus Healthcare is committed to working towards a high standard in recruitment - this is why we are a member of the Recruitment and Employment Confederation – this enables us to ensure that we are working at a high standard and we are committed to adhering to the REC Code of Professional Practice. You can read more about the Code by clicking here . Further to Pegasus Healthcare’s corporate membership, Simon is a Fellow of the REC. This further demonstrates the company’s commitment to working to a set of standards, including the REC Professional Member Code of Ethics, which you can view here .

Pegasus Healthcare is registered with the Care Inspectorate, No. 2022000069. Pegasus Healthcare is committed to working safely and in line with the laws of Scotland and the guidance provided by the Care Inspectorate. For more information relating to our registration, please click on the Care Inspectorate logo above – this link will take you to the Care Inspectorate’s website.

At Pegasus Healthcare, we know that times are changing and people want to work the hours that suit them and not to be dictated to. What people want out of work is no longer the same. This is why our jobs have flexibility built in – you work when you want to! We work with a number of organisations and pride ourselves in our ability to source you the role that best suits you. Having a great deal of knowledge and experience in the health and social care sectors, we can help you achieve your goals.

Experienced specialists in temporary staffing Last-minute provision of healthcare staff Temporary and Emergency staff Strict Registration Procedures & Compliance Good quality candidates screened 24 hour, 365 days a year service Great Customer Care Customised Service

Significantly Better Quality Of Hire We specialise in the temporary placement of healthcare staff, and we have an in-depth understanding of the requirements to cover temporary shifts. Robust Selection Process Implement a robust recruitment process. Recruiting can be unpredictable and challenging from time to time, especially in the search for best-fit talent. Locate The Right Candidate We have the expertise and experience over the years to locate and identify the right candidate to meet your temporary shift requirements.

About Bluestar Care & Support

First Step Toward
Better Living

We are a group of caring professionals at Bluestar Care & Support Ltd who are committed to improving the lives of those we serve. Founded on principles of empathy, excellence, and integrity, our mission is to offer personalized support that caters to the unique needs and desires of each individual.

Our Philosophy

We believe in providing care that goes beyond basic needs, focusing on comprehensive well-being that includes physical, emotional, social, and mental health. Our holistic approach ensures that our clients not only receive the essential care they need but also enjoy enriched and fulfilling lives.

Our Vision

Bluestar Care & Support Ltd envisions a world where care and support are not merely duties but heartfelt connections that empower individuals to live with dignity, grace, and joy. We strive to create an environment where every client feels at home, valued, and part of our extended family.

Our Services

Our extensive range of services includes Grocery Shopping, Light Housekeeping, Meal Prep and Nutrition, Social Activities and Connection, Transportation and Errands, Cognitive Engagement, and Meaningful Activities. Tailored to suit individual preferences and requirements, our services aim to provide comfort, independence, and joy in everyday living.

Our Team

Our dedicated team of caregivers, support staff, and healthcare professionals are at the heart of our success. Highly trained and committed to our values, they work collaboratively to deliver quality care with warmth and respect. Their unwavering commitment ensures that Bluestar is a name synonymous with trust and excellence in care.

Our Commitment to Quality

Bluestar Care & Support Ltd adheres to the highest standards of quality, maintaining rigorous protocols to ensure that our clients receive the best possible care. We are constantly seeking ways to innovate and enhance our services, keeping abreast of the latest developments in healthcare and support.

Community Involvement

We are proud to be part of the local communities we serve, actively participating in community events and supporting local causes. We believe that building strong community connections enriches the lives of our clients and contributes positively to the areas we operate in.

Living Wage Accreditation

Pegasus Healthcare is an accredited employer with the Living Wage Foundation. We are committed to our workers and to pay them a fair rate of pay. The benefits of doing this are to allow them more financial stability to help them spend more time with their families, to spend more time relaxing and exercising and to generally enjoy a higher quality of life. The threshold of the Living Wage is the minimum that Pegasus Healthcare commits to but we are dedicated to pass on the highest possible rates of pay to all staff

Recruitment and Employment Confederation Membership

Pegasus Healthcare is committed to working towards a high standard in recruitment - this is why we are a member of the Recruitment and Employment Confederation – this enables us to ensure that we are working at a high standard and we are committed to adhering to the REC Code of Professional Practice. You can read more about the Code by clicking here.

Further to Pegasus Healthcare’s corporate membership, Simon is a Fellow of the REC. This further demonstrates the company’s commitment to working to a set of standards, including the REC Professional Member Code of Ethics, which you can view here.

Care Inspectorate Registered

Pegasus Healthcare is registered with the Care Inspectorate, No. 2022000069. Pegasus Healthcare is committed to working safely and in line with the laws of Scotland and the guidance provided by the Care Inspectorate. For more information relating to our registration, please click on the Care Inspectorate logo above – this link will take you to the Care Inspectorate’s website.

Candidate

At Pegasus Healthcare, we know that times are changing and people want to work the hours that suit them and not to be dictated to. What people want out of work is no longer the same. This is why our jobs have flexibility built in – you work when you want to! We work with a number of organisations and pride ourselves in our ability to source you the role that best suits you. Having a great deal of knowledge and experience in the health and social care sectors, we can help you achieve your goals.
  • Experienced specialists in temporary staffing
  • Last-minute provision of healthcare staff
  • Temporary and Emergency staff
  • Strict Registration Procedures & Compliance
  • Good quality candidates screened
  • 24 hour, 365 days a year service
  • Great Customer Care
  • Customised Service
Significantly Better Quality Of Hire
We specialise in the temporary placement of healthcare staff, and we have an in-depth understanding of the requirements to cover temporary shifts.
Robust Selection Process
Implement a robust recruitment process. Recruiting can be unpredictable and challenging from time to time, especially in the search for best-fit talent.
Locate The Right Candidate
We have the expertise and experience over the years to locate and identify the right candidate to meet your temporary shift requirements.

candidate-app.title: Candidate App

texts: Find Healthcare Shifts At Your Fingertips

The Pegasus Healthcare mobile app is powered by an advanced staffing solution, designed to help candidates stay engaged with the vacancies available to us. As a registered Pegasus Healthcare candidate, you will have powerful tools at your disposal enabling you to stay updated on vacancies, update availability instantly, view bookings and sign timesheets on the app itself. The Pegasus Healthcare Candidate App makes it convenient for you as a candidate to make sure that you never miss a shift.
Candidates can apply for shifts with a click of a button. All vacancies published by Pegasus Healthcare will appear as a notification on the candidate app.
View bookings and update your availability and inform us through the Pegasus Healthcare candidate app. All confirmed shifts will be shown here.
Pegasus Healthcare allocates shifts though the mobile app, making it easier for you to be instantly updated.
As a candidate registered with Pegasus Healthcare, you are able to update your availability through the mobile app. It’s easy!
Easily upload your CV, compliance and eligibility documents through the Pegasus Healthcare mobile app.
You will receive document validity expiry notifications automatically on your mobile app, reminding you to renew your documents on time.
You can get the signature of the care home manager on the mobile device and submit the timesheet through the mobile app itself.

The Candidate Mobile App provides three-way communication. In addition to email, we also have a great Chat feature that helps you communicate with us at any time and get quick responses via chat and push notifications.
As a Pegasus Healthcare candidate, you can send a request amount from the mobile app for Holiday Pay.
View job location on the mobile app itself with inbuilt maps feature.

job-seekers.title: Job Seekers

texts: Collectively, we will work hand in hand to turn this vision into a reality!
If you have prior professional experience in a care home, hospital, or home care setting, that’s fantastic! We value your expertise and would be delighted to consider you for available positions.

Alternatively, if you haven’t worked in the care field before but have cared for a family member or friend, we have a limited number of roles available for individuals with care giving experience outside of a professional setting. We are committed to providing the necessary training and support to help you transition into your new career.

To be part of our team, it is crucial to possess a sincere compassion for others, effective communication skills, and the ability to comprehend and follow instructions related to the role. While prior care experience is beneficial, it is not always mandatory as we provide comprehensive training to all our staff members.

Having access to your own transportation and having flexible availability are advantageous qualities. At our organization, we offer competitive rates, flexibility in scheduling, extensive training opportunities, and the necessary support to ensure you can excel in your role.
Regardless of your background, we are excited to hear from you and discuss potential opportunities. Your passion for care and dedication to making a difference are what matter most to us.
